title: Metabolite Extraction and Protein Analysis Workflow
summary: This cluster describes a workflow for metabolite extraction and protein analysis. Metabolite Extraction employs various methods, including TissueLyser LT and centrifugation, to produce supernatant from cell pellets. The supernatant is then used to extract proteins, which are analyzed using Western blot analysis and polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis. The latter involves blotting proteins onto a 0.45 μm membrane and normalizing signals. Invitrogen NuPAGE is used for polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis, and following antibodies are used for Western blot analysis. The workflow is provided by Novogene Co. and involves various chemicals, including ACN, Ascorbic acid, and MeOH.
